gates.name: truthful documentary and disclosed conceptual imagery system

assumptions: The authorized repository owner controls the requested GitHub repository and authorizes this Kingxford implementation.
English is the only language required for this release.
Licensed contextual photography does not assert affiliation, participation, endorsement, or a documented project outcome.
Disclosed conceptual editorial imagery does not assert a literal product interface, real Kingxford facility, employee identity, participant, or measured project outcome.
No narration asset is shipped; future audio remains optional and must pass the documented consent, editorial, and listening review before publication.
No environment variables are required for the public portfolio unless the deployment workflow reports otherwise.
open_questions: Which direct company email or form destination should replace the public GitHub contact path in a future release?
Should a future release connect a custom CMS for project and Media publishing?
Should a future Media release commission a professional narrator or approve a disclosed, editorially reviewed synthetic voice under creative/narration-policy.md?

risks.mitigation: Use factual alt text, visible conceptual-image captions where appropriate, and adjacent project copy; never describe contextual or synthetic imagery as literal evidence from the represented work.
Keep synthetic disclosure visible and consistent; prohibit fabricated readable text, interfaces, metrics, testimonials, facilities, staff identities, and outcome claims.
Use optimized local WebP plates, CSS/Motion transforms, native scroll, and a reduced-motion static path.
Deploy and verify the Vercel production URL; treat custom-domain DNS as a separate owner-controlled configuration.
